name: Desparkening
description: The loss of planeswalker sparks after the Sylex Blast in the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Basri loses his planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening.

timeline.summary: Most Planeswalkers lose their sparks in the Desparkening.
timeline.quote: the vast majority of Planeswalkers subsequently lost their sparks in the Desparkening

citation.text: "Planeswalker spark", section "New Phyrexian Planeswalkers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath loses his spark in the Desparkening and travels with his daughters through Omenpaths, agreeing Jamira should attend Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Angrath lost his spark in the Desparkening .

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn refuse Realmbreaker with Elspeth's return as an archangel; Norn's demise neutralizes the Phyrexians, but the Desparkening costs many their spark.
timeline.quote: Chandra and Wrenn went to New Phyrexia in a second attempt to refuse Realmbreaker, which was successful with Elspeth's return as an archangel

timeline.summary: The Desparkening strips most planeswalkers of their sparks.
